title: The Origin of Cultivation and Proto-Weeds, Long Before Neolithic Farming (Snir and others, 2015)

source.license: CC BY 4.0 (stated in the PDF; the PLoS ONE page links the 4.0 deed)

summary: Finds weeds and seeds in a 23,000-year-old site on the Sea of Galilee, arguing that people began cultivating long before the Neolithic. Context for the world lane on early farming.
